articles.summary: ASHEVILLE, N.C., Oct. 22, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- HomeTrust Bancshares, Inc. (NYSE: HTB) ("Company"), the holding company of HomeTrust Bank ("Bank"), today announced preliminary net income for the third quarter of the year ending December 31, 2025 and an increase in its quarterly cash dividend.
articles.title: HomeTrust Bancshares, Inc. Announces Financial Results for the Third Quarter of the Year Ending December 31, 2025 and an Increase in the Quarterly Dividend
